actions.rationale: Sidecar open_positions is empty, so OPEN rather than HOLD/ADD. UNKNOWN: whether trimmed-mean 3.6%, the energy shock, or one more RBA hike lands before the housing channel dominates. Sidecar open_positions is empty, so this is a new OPEN versus the $100m cap, not an add to an existing IB position.
